body:
This is a note about what happens when two similer drugs get mixed to form one 'super' drug.
As a paramedic I get to see a lot of nasty stuff as part of my job. As a bit of a cookie monster I get to experience some pretty great stuff to compensate. But when Ketamine is combined with GHB to form the ultimate party pill, both of my passions cross to form something I never want to experience again.
On the last weekend just gone, my home state played host to the annual Two Tribes dance event. I was on the job, but a couple of my mates were going along and gave me a tip off that there was going to be some evil pills floating around, and that I may get a call out or two. They reckoned that it was Ketamine combined with GHB to make the 'ultimate sensory high' I thought nothing of it and attended the usual Sunday night workload
Around about 5am we got a page to attend priority 1 (lights and sirens) at the venue that the event was being held at. All the info we were given was suspected O.D. once we arrived we found a raver in the throes of a pretty serious seizure followed by unconsciousness, almost no pulse or breathing. After stabilisation we transported him down to the local accident and emergency. Soon after this was followed by two more that my partner and I attended, along with another nine by other crews within a four hour period. By the end of the weekend there was an unofficial total of nineteen incidents all from the same event and recovery within a twelve hour period
I found out later that they had all taken a GHB Ketamine cocktail that they thought was e.
GHB has only taken off in the past couple of years in Australia, so combo's are only starting to make it onto the market now.
